expectedProductCount.evidence: Live walk 2026-05-13T08:44:19Z..08:45:01Z. Page 0 pager 'pager__item--last' href = 'page=1670' (zero-indexed). Pages 100, 500, 1000, 1500, 1668, 1669 each have 18 unique node IDs (data-history-node-id). Page 1670 has exactly 17 unique node IDs and NO 'pager__item--next' / NO 'pager__item--last' (terminus confirmed). Pages 1671 / 1690 / 1700 / 5000 / 100000 each return 3 items but they are NOT real catalog items: they differ on every page request, none present on page 0, no pager. They are Drupal Views 'empty-results filler' (sticky/recommended ads) on out-of-range pages. Real count = (1670 mid-pages * 18) + 17 = 30,060 + 17 = 30,077. R1's 30,078 was off by 1 (assumed page 1670 had 18). DB's 30,423 was wrong: DB assumed terminus at page 1690 with 3 items, but 'page=1690' is out-of-range filler not a real page. Actual terminus is page 1670.
